text: Replace pointwise BCE with within-user pairwise BPR, sampling one positive and one negative impression per eligible training user while retaining the factorization-machine architecture, request-context features, split, and evaluation protocol.
rationale: The official model ranks within users, so pairwise optimization directly targets the ordering objective. The current model has a sizable gap between global AUC and GAUC, suggesting row-level BCE optimization may not fully align with within-user ranking.
exact_ablation: Ablate pointwise BCE training and replace it with one sampled within-user BPR positive-negative pair per eligible user; change no features, architecture, split, or evaluator.

expected_effect.GAUC: Expected increase of 0.003 to 0.010 from better positive-versus-negative ordering; estimated validation GAUC 0.672 to 0.679.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Expected increase of 0.002 to 0.008, especially for users with two to four positives where current nDCG@5 is 0.7698 but ranking quality remains sensitive to ordering.
